findings.excerpt: [F1] *def-axiom-of-choice.* The **Axiom of Choice** (AC) is the following statement. > Every family of nonempty sets has a choice function > (def-choice-function). Written out: for every set $\mathcal{F}$ all of whose members are nonempty, there exists a function $g$ with domain $\mathcal{F}$ satisfying $g(S) \in S$ for all $S \in \mathcal{F}$. ([[def-axiom-of-choice]])
findings.symptom: The rendered fact exposes literal “>” delimiters and the parenthesized def-choice-function marker in the prose, breaking the Axiom of Choice sentence.
findings.suggested_repair: Replace the angle-bracket delimiters and parenthetical marker with ordinary prose; retain the linked definition reference.
